description: This file defines the ApplicationCostProfilerClient class, which extends AwsClient and provides methods to interact with the AWS Application Cost Profiler service. It includes method annotations for various operations such as delete, get, import, list, put, and update report definitions, both synchronously and asynchronously.

classes.name: ApplicationCostProfilerClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with the AWS Application Cost Profiler service, extending AwsClient to provide specific methods for report management.

methods.name: deleteReportDefinition
methods.description: Deletes a report definition in the Application Cost Profiler service.

methods.name: putReportDefinition
methods.description: Creates or updates a report definition.

methods.name: putReportDefinitionAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates or updates a report definition.
